newsitem.title: USA: Art's-Way looks for profitable FY97.
newsitem.headline: Art's-Way looks for profitable FY97.

text.p: Art's-Way Manufacturing Co Inc said Tuesday benefits from acquisitions, recovering demand for feed processing equipment and strong cash flow will result in a profitable fiscal 1997.

For the third quarter ended February 28, the company reported a loss of $0.02 per share compared to a year-ago loss of $0.10. For the nine months, it incurred a loss of $0.12 per share compared to a year-earlier loss of $0.56 per share.
Art's-Way manufactures and distributes agricultural-related niche products such as animal feed processing products and land maintenance products.
